novelty.justification: The claim proposes that “each fact has an acquisition-language anchor” and that “cross-lingual recall is routed through that anchor’s representation regardless of query language,” so its main novelty route is a per-fact mechanistic routing account rather than merely a new multilingual failure setting. Searches for “acquisition language cross-lingual factual recall,” “language-specific factual knowledge storage multilingual LLM,” and “English-centric multilingual factual recall pipeline” identify ECLeKTic (2025), which already defines facts by the language in which they were likely learned and reports success there but failure in other languages; Language Models’ Factuality Depends on the Language of Inquiry (2025), which explicitly reports Arabic-success/English-failure cases; Paths Not Taken (2025), which supplies the competing English-centric routing mechanism and activation interventions; and Tracing Multilingual Factual Knowledge Acquisition in Pretraining (2025), which relates per-fact corpus frequency and language to acquisition. Moving from those works to a decodable, causally suppressible per-fact anchor is a substantive multi-step integration and mechanistic operationalization, but the reverse-direction phenomenon and acquisition-language framing already exist, making this a natural extension rather than a wholly new core problem or paradigm.
